title: Travel and subsistence approval
statement: Travel or subsistence spend above £750 requires written approval from the relevant budget owner before booking. An item must not be split into smaller transactions to avoid the threshold. The claimant must submit an itemised receipt and business purpose within ten calendar days after the trip.
summary: Travel spend above £750 needs advance budget-owner approval, and claims need receipts within ten days.

title: Customer support first-response targets
statement: Priority-one customer cases require a human first response within fifteen minutes and continuous ownership until stabilisation. Priority-two cases require a first response within four business hours. Priority-three cases require a first response by the end of the next business day. Automated acknowledgements do not count as a human first response.
summary: Support targets are fifteen minutes for P1, four business hours for P2, and next business day for P3.
